article.headline: Suspended Rassie Erasmus Risks Breach After Hosting Unauthorized Online Matchday Watchalong
article.summary: South Africa head coach Rassie Erasmus held a livestream during the Ireland vs Springboks match while serving a six-match ban.
article.body:
Thumping his table in frustration while watching Ireland secure a 20-17 victory, South Africa head coach Rassie Erasmus spent the match in a Dublin hotel room rather than the Aviva Stadium. The 54-year-old, currently serving a six-match suspension handed down by World Rugby, hosted a public watchalong session that saw him appear on camera during both halves of the Nations Championship clash. While the suspension already prohibits him from matchday coaching or contact with team management, the event has drawn scrutiny from rugby's governing body regarding the terms of his ban. Sky Sports reports that officials are evaluating whether his actions constitute a breach of his restricted duties.

The potential fallout extends beyond World Rugby's disciplinary findings. According to The Guardian, Six Nations and Sanzaar executives have monitored the stream for copyright violations. While Erasmus is permitted to discuss the game, any broadcast of official match footage could trigger legal action from tournament organizers and rights holders like SuperSport, ITV, and Virgin Media. These organizations maintain strict anti-piracy measures and assigned staff to track the broadcast.

Erasmus received his suspension following public claims of match-fixing and manipulation after a previous defeat to France. The disciplinary panel ruled that he must refrain from stadium access, media duties, and all communication with players or staff on matchdays. Although he remained muted for most of the broadcast, Erasmus spoke during half-time to critique his team's performance, suggesting they needed to step up to avoid a narrow result. He justified the event on social media by stating he was not keen to watch the game alone. The governing body and tournament organizers continue to review the situation to determine if further sanctions or legal steps are warranted.

article.headline: Carlos Espí clinches Real Madrid comeback win over Celta at Bernabéu
article.summary: Carlos Espí scored the winning goal in a 2-1 victory against Celta de Vigo, extending Real Madrid's winning streak to nine consecutive games.
article.body:
Carlos Espí described having goosebumps after netting his first home goal for Real Madrid, a strike that secured a dramatic 2-1 comeback victory against Celta de Vigo. The 21-year-old forward emphasized the significance of the moment, noting that scoring his first goal at the Santiago Bernabéu felt like a dream after previously scoring three times on the road. The win solidified the home ground as a fortress, with Real Madrid continuing its perfect streak of victories at the stadium this season.

This victory is vital for Real Madrid as it marks their ninth consecutive win across all competitions, maintaining their momentum in both La Liga and the Champions League. For the players and the club, keeping the home record perfect is a priority, as Espí noted that the team cannot afford to drop points in front of their supporters. The win serves as a high-stakes confidence booster before the team transitions immediately to their next challenge.

According to reports from HolaNews, the match was a difficult test that required the squad to overcome adversity and stay focused throughout the encounter. Marca notes that the team returned to the Bernabéu following a demanding series of four consecutive away matches, including victories against Barcelona and Valencia. The squad remains unified, with players emphasizing that every minute on the pitch must be maximized to keep the current winning form alive.

The team has little time to celebrate the result. Espí confirmed that preparation for the upcoming Champions League fixture begins immediately, with only two days available to ready the squad for the next battle.

article.headline: France Clashes With South Africa In Inaugural Nations Championship Twickenham Final
article.summary: France and South Africa face off in the inaugural Nations Championship final at Allianz Stadium on November 29 following the conclusion of the pool stage.
article.body:
South Africa secured a spot in the final despite suffering consecutive defeats, including a 17-20 loss to Ireland in Dublin. The Springboks finished at the top of the southern hemisphere table after New Zealand failed to earn bonus points during a loss to England at Twickenham. France claimed their place in the final by topping the northern hemisphere table following a 45-17 victory over Argentina in Paris.

The Nations Championship serves as a new joint venture between Six Nations and SANZAAR, aiming to provide more structure and consistent international matchups between northern and southern hemisphere teams. This alignment ensures high-profile fixtures outside of the World Cup window, with the inaugural tournament featuring twelve teams including Fiji and Japan.

According to Sky Sports and Rugby365, the finals weekend at Allianz Stadium will determine final tournament standings based on corresponding finishes from both hemispheres. Following the headline event between France and South Africa, England is scheduled to face New Zealand in a rematch, while Ireland takes on Australia. Other fixtures include Scotland versus Argentina, Wales against Japan, and Italy facing Fiji.

The tournament conclusion takes place across three days at the end of November. Following these matchups, international teams will conclude their involvement in this first edition of the competition.

article.headline: Columbus Crew routs Inter Miami 3-0 in opening MLS playoff series game
article.summary: Seventh-seeded Columbus Crew secured a 3-0 victory over Inter Miami on Saturday to take the lead in their best-of-three MLS Cup playoff series.
article.body:
Lionel Messi narrowly avoided an ejection during the first half after throwing a ball into the face of Columbus forward Gonzalo Tapia. While the incident resulted only in a yellow card for both players, Columbus coach Laurent Courtois argued post-match that the superstar deserved a red card. Referee Allen Chapman defended the decision, claiming the force used was negligible and did not constitute violent conduct. Miami struggled throughout the evening, finishing the match with 10 men and failing to contain a clinical Columbus attack.

The decisive loss leaves Inter Miami on the brink of an early postseason exit. The club must now secure a victory in the next match to force a tie-breaking game, as their current deficit puts them in a precarious position within the best-of-three series. Miami coach Kily González acknowledged the performance was subpar, describing it as a test of character for his squad.

Gonzalo Tapia opened the scoring with an early penalty before adding his second goal later in the match at Nu Stadium. Taha Habroune also contributed to the tally, doubling the lead shortly after half-time. According to The Guardian, nothing went right for Miami as the team effectively gifted chances to their opponents. 

Inter Miami faces a must-win scenario in the second game of the series. The teams are scheduled to meet again in Ohio next Friday to determine if the series continues to a final deciding match.

article.headline: طقس الأحد: حرارة تصل لـ33 درجة وشبورة كثيفة تغطي الطرق صباحًا
article.summary: تتوقع هيئة الأرصاد الجوية طقسًا معتدلًا إلى مائل للحرارة نهارًا يوم الأحد 22 نوفمبر 2026 مع فرص أمطار خفيفة.
article.body:
تصل درجات الحرارة العظمى في أسوان إلى 33 درجة مئوية، بينما تنخفض الصغرى في الإسماعيلية إلى 13 درجة، في تباين ملحوظ يشهده طقس الأحد 22 نوفمبر 2026. وتضع الهيئة العامة للأرصاد الجوية المواطنين أمام مشهد جوي متقلب، حيث تتراوح الأجواء بين الاعتدال نهارًا والبرودة الواضحة في الصباح الباكر والليل على أغلب أنحاء البلاد.

تكمن أهمية هذه التوقعات في التحذير من الشبورة المائية التي قد تصل إلى حد الكثافة خلال ساعات الصباح الباكر، من الساعة الرابعة حتى التاسعة صباحًا، مما يفرض على السائقين توخي الحذر الشديد على الطرق المؤدية من وإلى شمال البلاد، القاهرة الكبرى، مدن القناة، وسط سيناء، وشمال الصعيد.

ووفقًا لما أعلنته الهيئة، تشهد المناطق السواحل الشمالية الغربية وشمال الوجه البحري ومدن حلايب وشلاتين فرصًا لسقوط أمطار خفيفة بنسبة حدوث تصل إلى 30% على فترات متقطعة. كما تتكون بعض السحب على شمال البلاد حتى القاهرة الكبرى ومدن القناة، مع احتمالية ضعيفة جدًا لسقوط أمطار خفيفة بنسبة 10%. وتسجل القاهرة العظمى 26 درجة والصغرى 17، بينما تشهد شرم الشيخ عظمى تصل إلى 31 درجة.

تأتي هذه التحذيرات في إطار سعي الهيئة للحد من الآثار الناتجة عن الظواهر الجوية المتوقعة، حيث ناشدت المواطنين اتخاذ الاستعدادات اللازمة ومتابعة التحديثات الرسمية الصادرة عنها بصفة مستمرة لضمان السلامة العامة خلال تنقلاتهم اليومية في ظل تقلبات الطقس.
